Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production adventure-map city sprite, one original standalone building
Primary request: Create one Hearthguard city sprite: a broad cream-limestone civic gatehouse with warm red tile roofs, two sturdy square towers, wrought-iron braces, restrained gold heraldic trim, and exactly one generous central arched entrance. It must feel welcoming and defended, never cathedral-like or imperial.
Scene/backdrop: perfectly flat solid #00FF00 chroma-key background for local background removal.
Style/medium: bright cartoony hand-pixelled storybook pixel art, crisp selective dark outlines, compact painterly pixel clusters, restrained palette, readable at 160x160 native size.
Composition/framing: one complete isolated city, front-facing high-oblique non-isometric adventure-map camera with a slight overhead tilt and visible roofs; broad five-tile-wide silhouette. Design for a square 160x160 logical canvas. The bottom two tile rows are the 5x2 building contact. Place the only entrance visibly dead-center over bottom tile column 2 of 0..4, centered at x=80 and reaching the bottom edge. Keep the silhouette inside the canvas with small transparent padding above and at both sides. Horizontal ground contact, never a diamond or corner-on view.
Lighting/mood: cheerful warm key light from screen lower-right/map south-east; self-shadowed planes face screen upper-left/map north-west. No cast or contact shadow.
Constraints: perfectly uniform #00FF00 background with no variation; no #00FF00 in the subject; exactly one visible door/gate; architecture only; opaque hard-edged subject suitable for chroma removal.
Avoid: terrain, grass, plants, rocks, path, road, ground plate, scenery, horizon, characters, owner colors, flags, flagpoles, banners, text, labels, emblem plaques, UI, watermark, gradients or texture in the background, glow, reflection, smoke, cast shadow, contact shadow, extra doors, secondary gates, isometric diamond.
